title: Android occasional app crash on focus out (analytics report) in `Callable::is_custom()` and `StringName::operator==()` (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on 4.5.1.stable and 4.6.beta2
- No idea yet about other versions

### System information

Android 13 to 16 Beta, various devices

### Issue description

This is an issue based on crash reports gotten for the Godot editor app on Google Play.

We have stacktraces and device information but no logcat or information about what the user was doing.

The stacktrace typically looks like this:

For Android maintainers who have Play Console access: https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/33c110942cd6c1c45599e75f391f53bd/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true

A similar stacktrace was also seen on Rift Riff.

These ones imply the Vulkan render view, it's not clear yet whether the same can happen with the GL render view.

Possibly related:
- #106120

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Godot Editor or Rift Riff, possibly any Vulkan project?
